lane: co-training with disagreement as the discovery signal (shared H60D instrument)
question: Does the shared negative sampler leak held-out catalogue geometry into hide-and-recover holdout scores?

mechanism_under_test.defect: negatives are drawn from the whole footprint (including held-out fold region) and cleared by 5 px (500 m) from the FULL catalogue (including held-out fold truth). Held-out fault neighbourhoods are therefore never sampled as negatives, and held-out region labels shape the training set.
mechanism_under_test.named_non_fault_mimic: a smooth geophysical gradient that is simply absent from the negative sample near any fault (sampling artefact), rather than a learned fault signature

arms.shipped: as in H60D: fit on fit-region positives + negatives from full footprint cleared by full catalogue
arms.clean: fit-region only: positives cat&fit, negatives from valid&fit cleared by cat&fit (no held-out labels touch training)

instrument: gems52 HO.make_folds(hide, n_folds=4, buffer_px=4, prevalence=0.002, seed=H60D SEED); legal = region & permitted & ~corridor(visible); R=300 m; alpha 0.2 beta 0.8; budgets 37654 and 15000 px; iso_select 3 px
primary_contrast: paired per-fold DTI difference clean minus shipped, for view_B and dis_contrast at 37654 px

decision_rule.leak_confirmed: primary paired difference (clean - shipped) has fold-bootstrap 95% CI entirely below 0 for view_B AND for view_A at 37654 px
decision_rule.clean_helps: CI entirely above 0 (would mean the shipped sampler suppressed signal; reported, not promoted)

leakage_canary: AUC of each field alone against held-out truth in the legal set (bar 0.90); h60d.layer_auc_canary
budget: 1 experiment of the 3 allowed this session
promotion: none: this round can at most produce a corrected instrument, never a submission
